description: A relaxed coastal pack mixing recognizable waterfront landmarks with small local details.

routes.name: Coastal Morning Run
routes.description: An out-and-back route along the central Tran Phu waterfront. Stay on public pedestrian areas and use marked crossings.

landmarks.name: Tram Huong Tower
landmarks.description: A recognizable tower beside the central waterfront square.

landmarks.name: Tran Phu Beach
landmarks.description: The central public beachfront and promenade.

safetyNotes: This route is descriptive, not a guarantee of safety or access.
Use public pedestrian areas and marked road crossings.
Stop if weather, crowds, construction, or traffic make the route unsuitable.

quests.title: Frame the Tower
quests.prompt: Photograph Tram Huong Tower with a natural frame such as a tree, railing, or shadow.

fallback.instructions: If GPS is inaccurate, confirm that you are in the public square and add a caption.

quests.title: Coastal Reflection
quests.prompt: Find a safe reflection of the sea in glass, water, or a polished surface.

fallback.instructions: Use the beachfront fallback only from a public pedestrian area.

quests.title: Local Pattern Hunt
quests.prompt: Capture an overlooked pavement, garden, or architectural pattern without blocking other pedestrians.

fallback.instructions: Skip this quest if the area is crowded or the detail is inaccessible.

pointsOfInterest.name: Central Waterfront
pointsOfInterest.description: A cluster of bundled photo quests near the central promenade.

pointsOfInterest.name: North Promenade Details
pointsOfInterest.description: Small public-space details north of the central square.
